name: universal-software-mcp-builder
description: Production-grade engineering framework and scaffolding to design, build, audit, and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for any desktop, scientific, and industrial software (CAE/CAD/EDA/simulation tools).

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold and build production MCP servers for any heavy software
interface.longDescription:
The definitive engineering workflow, architectural standards, and scaffolding for building bulletproof Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for complex desktop, scientific, and industrial software (COMSOL, ANSYS, Abaqus, MATLAB, SolidWorks, Star-CCM+, etc.).

Features:
- 7 Core Architectural Pillars: Crash isolation, Base64 zero-escape IPC, Copy-on-Write immutability, floating license management, offscreen rendering, and heavy data downsampling.
- Ready-to-use FastMCP production server template.
- 6-Stage implementation workflow from runtime audit to MCP exposition.
- Enterprise OAuth 2.1 authentication and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) dangerous action guards.
- 4-Layer MCP testing pyramid and CI pipeline configurations.
capabilities: Architectural blueprint generation for any native desktop software
FastMCP production scaffolding generator (async tasks, license queue, CoW)
Native bridge design (JNA/Java, C++/CLI, COM/ActiveX, IPC pipes)
Security, OAuth 2.1, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) guardrail templates
4-layer MCP testing pyramid and CI pipeline configurations
